acceptedAnswer.text: Knockio Service CRM is a customer and field service management system that covers everything from the first lead to the final payment: customer details, jobs, crews, schedules, estimates, and invoices. It keeps that data connected so sales teams, office staff, and field crews all work from the same system.

mainEntity.name: How does Knockio help field service teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Knockio covers the full workflow: capturing leads, storing customer details, creating estimates, scheduling jobs, assigning crews, tracking job progress, uploading photos, sending invoices, and following up with customers afterward.

mainEntity.name: Can Knockio manage customer and job history?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Knockio keeps a customer's notes, past visits, job details, photos, documents, invoices, payments, and messages together on their profile, so your team can see what happened before and what's next.

mainEntity.name: Does Knockio support estimates and invoices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Create estimates and digital proposals, then move approved work straight into scheduling, invoicing, and payment — all inside the same CRM.

mainEntity.name: Is Knockio useful for both sales and service teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — Knockio connects sales activity with service delivery, so leads captured in Knockio's canvassing app can move into scheduled jobs without switching tools.
